target.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile
target.body:
## Summary

- Recognize explicit OpenClaw plugin directories (or `openclaw.plugin.json`) as first-class `plugin` targets with stable manifest identity, ambiguity rejection, and symlink-hardened manifest reads.
- Give plugins parity with skills under the built-in `clawhub` profile: `clawscan-static`, SkillSpector, and VirusTotal all run, and the bundled Codex judge receives production-compatible `packageRelease` evidence context.
- Scan the complete plugin directory: SkillSpector sees plugin code and manifest files; VirusTotal hashes/uploads a deterministic `plugin.zip`; the constrained judge workspace prioritizes `openclaw.plugin.json`.
- Preserve skill behavior and target-aware credential/Docker gating. Other skill-only scanners still return an explicit `skipped` result for plugins.

## Scope

- [x] CLI behavior
- [x] Scanner adapters
- [x] ClawHub judge/profile behavior
- [x] Docs
- [ ] Benchmark behavior
- [ ] Release/CI/repo automation

## Security / Trust Impact

Plugin contents remain untrusted throughout classification and staging. Manifest discovery uses `lstat`; manifest reads use `O_NOFOLLOW` plus a same-file re-check; identity is size-capped and validated without recording host paths. A directory containing both `SKILL.md` and `openclaw.plugin.json` fails closed as ambiguous.

VirusTotal parity deliberately matches existing skill behavior: a local deterministic ZIP of the full target is submitted when its hash is unknown. Standard VirusTotal uploads may enter its shared corpus, so operators should not scan confidential packages with a public key.

## Verification

- [x] `go test -count=1 ./...`
- [x] `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] CLI builds with `-buildvcs=false`
- [x] `git diff --check`
- [x] Docs build/check
- [x] Owned-plugin live E2E with `ghcr.io/openclaw/clawscan-runtime:latest`: SkillSpector 2.3.7 scanned `index.js` and `openclaw.plugin.json` (2/2 components, 100% coverage, no residual container)
- [x] GPT-5.6-SOL xhigh autoreview: no actionable findings, patch correct (0.90 confidence)

## What was not tested

- No live VirusTotal request was made for this update; upload/report behavior is covered by the HTTP integration harness and deterministic ZIP tests.
- Plain local `go build` hit an environment VCS-stamping exit 128; the equivalent `go build -buildvcs=false` commands passed.

## Notes

Plugins are never auto-discovered; callers must pass the plugin directory or manifest explicitly. JSON5-only manifests remain outside this change and fail with a clear strict-JSON error.
